name: ballerina/ftp
description: This module provides an FTP/SFTP client and an FTP/SFTP server listener implementation to facilitate an FTP/SFTP connection connected to a remote location. Additionally, it supports FTPS (FTP over SSL/TLS) to facilitate secure file transfers.

Delete action for file processing.
When specified, the file will be deleted after processing.

typeDefs.name: MOVE

typeDefs.name: FtpFunctionConfig
typeDefs.description:
Configuration for FTP service remote functions.
Use this to override default file extension routing for content methods and
specify automatic file actions after processing.

fields.name: fileNamePattern
fields.description: File name pattern (regex) that routes files to this method. Must be a subset of the listener's `fileNamePattern`

fields.name: afterProcess
fields.description:
Action to perform after successful processing. Can be `DELETE` or `MOVE`.
If not specified, no action is taken (file remains in place)

fields.name: afterError
fields.description:
Action to perform after a processing error. Can be `DELETE` or `MOVE`.
Also applied when content binding fails (e.g. malformed CSV/JSON/XML) and
no `onError` method is declared.
If not specified, no action is taken (file remains in place)

typeDefs.name: ServiceConfiguration
typeDefs.description:
Configuration for FTP service monitoring.
Use this to specify the directory path and file patterns this service should monitor.

fields.description: Directory path on the FTP server to monitor for file changes

fields.name: fileNamePattern
fields.description: File name pattern (regex) to filter which files trigger events

fields.name: fileAgeFilter
fields.description: Configuration for filtering files based on age

fields.name: fileDependencyConditions
fields.description: Dependency conditions for conditional file processing

typeDefs.name: FileAgeFilter
typeDefs.description:
Filters files based on their age to control which files trigger listener events.
Useful for processing only files within a specific age range (e.g., skip very new files or very old files).

fields.name: minAge
fields.description:
Minimum age of the file in seconds (inclusive). Files younger than this are skipped.
If not specified, no minimum age requirement is applied

fields.name: maxAge
fields.description:
Maximum age of the file in seconds (inclusive). Files older than this are skipped.
If not specified, no maximum age requirement is applied

fields.name: ageCalculationMode
fields.description: Whether to calculate age based on last modified time or creation time

typeDefs.name: AgeCalculationMode
typeDefs.description: Determines the timestamp used when calculating file age for filtering.

members.name: CREATION_TIME
members.description: Use file's creation timestamp (where supported by file system)

members.name: LAST_MODIFIED
members.description: Use file's last modified timestamp

typeDefs.name: FileDependencyCondition
typeDefs.description:
Defines a dependency condition where processing of target files depends on the existence of other files.
This allows conditional file processing based on the presence of related files (e.g., processing a data file only
when a corresponding marker file exists). Supports capture group substitution to dynamically match related files.

fields.name: targetPattern
fields.description: Regex pattern for files that should be processed conditionally

fields.name: requiredFiles
fields.description: File patterns that must exist before processing. Supports capture group substitution (e.g., `$1`)

fields.name: matchingMode
fields.description: How to match required files

fields.name: requiredFileCount
fields.description: For EXACT_COUNT mode, specifies the exact number of required files that must match

typeDefs.name: DependencyMatchingMode
typeDefs.description:
Determines how to match required files when evaluating file dependencies.
Controls whether all dependencies must be present, at least one, or a specific count.

members.name: EXACT_COUNT
members.description: Exact number of required files must match (count specified in `requiredFileCount`)

members.name: ANY
members.description: At least one required file pattern must have a matching file

members.name: ALL
members.description: All required file patterns must have at least one matching file

typeDefs.name: RetryConfig
typeDefs.description:
Configuration for retry behavior on transient failures.
Enables automatic retry with exponential backoff for read operations.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Maximum number of retry attempts

fields.name: interval
fields.description: Initial wait time in seconds between retries

fields.name: backOffFactor
fields.description: Multiplier applied to the wait interval after each retry (exponential backoff)

fields.name: maxWaitInterval
fields.description: Maximum wait time cap in seconds between retries

typeDefs.name: CircuitBreakerConfig
typeDefs.description:
Configuration for circuit breaker behavior.
The circuit breaker prevents cascade failures by temporarily blocking requests when the server is experiencing issues.

fields.name: rollingWindow
fields.description: Time window configuration for failure tracking

fields.name: failureThreshold
fields.description:
Failure ratio threshold (0.0 to 1.0) that trips the circuit open.
For example, 0.5 means the circuit opens when 50% of requests fail

fields.name: resetTime
fields.description: Seconds to wait in OPEN state before transitioning to HALF_OPEN to test recovery

fields.name: failureCategories
fields.description: Error categories that count as failures. Only errors matching these categories contribute to the failure ratio

typeDefs.name: RollingWindow
typeDefs.description:
Configuration for the sliding time window used in failure calculation.
The rolling window divides time into discrete buckets for efficient tracking of request success/failure rates.

fields.name: requestVolumeThreshold
fields.description:
Minimum number of requests in the window before the circuit breaker evaluates the failure threshold.
The circuit breaker will not trip until this many requests have been made

fields.name: timeWindow
fields.description: Time period in seconds for the sliding window

fields.name: bucketSize
fields.description: Granularity of time buckets in seconds. Must be less than `timeWindow`

typeDefs.name: FailureCategory
typeDefs.description:
Categories of errors that can trip the circuit breaker.
Used to configure which types of failures should count towards the circuit breaker threshold.

members.name: ALL_ERRORS
members.description: All errors regardless of type

members.name: TRANSIENT_ERROR
members.description: Transient server errors that may succeed on retry (FTP codes 421, 425, 426, 450, 451, 452)

members.name: AUTHENTICATION_ERROR
members.description: Authentication failures (invalid credentials, key rejected)

members.name: CONNECTION_ERROR
members.description: Connection-level failures (timeout, refused, reset, DNS resolution)

typeDefs.name: Error
typeDefs.description: Defines the common error type for the module.

typeDefs.name: ConnectionError
typeDefs.description:
Error when connecting to the FTP/SFTP server.
This includes network failures, host unreachable, connection refused, etc.

typeDefs.name: FileNotFoundError
typeDefs.description: Error when a requested file or directory is not found.

typeDefs.name: FileAlreadyExistsError
typeDefs.description: Error when attempting to create a file or directory that already exists.

typeDefs.name: InvalidConfigError
typeDefs.description:
Error when FTP/SFTP configuration is invalid.
This includes invalid port numbers, invalid regex patterns, invalid timeout values, etc.

typeDefs.name: ServiceUnavailableError
typeDefs.description:
Error when the FTP/SFTP service is temporarily unavailable.
This is a transient error indicating the operation may succeed on retry.
Common causes include: server overload (421), connection issues (425, 426),
temporary file locks (450), or server-side processing errors (451).

typeDefs.name: ContentBindingErrorDetail
typeDefs.description: Detail record for ContentBindingError providing additional context about the binding failure.

fields.name: filePath
fields.description: The file path that caused the error

fields.name: content
fields.description: The raw file content as bytes that failed to bind

typeDefs.name: ContentBindingError
typeDefs.description:
Error when file content cannot be converted to the expected type.
This includes JSON/XML parsing errors, CSV format errors, and record type binding failures.
This error type is applicable to both Client operations and Listener callbacks.

When used with the Listener, if an `onError` remote function is defined in the service,
it will be invoked with this error type, allowing for custom error handling such as
moving failed files to an error folder or sending notifications.

typeDefs.name: AllRetryAttemptsFailedError
typeDefs.description:
Error when all retry attempts have been exhausted.
This error wraps the last failure encountered during retry attempts.

typeDefs.name: CircuitBreakerOpenError
typeDefs.description:
Error returned when the circuit breaker is in OPEN state.
This indicates the FTP server is unavailable and requests are being blocked
to prevent cascade failures. The client should implement fallback logic
or wait for the circuit to transition to HALF_OPEN state.

parameters.name: fileInfo
parameters.description: The file's name, path, size, and timestamps.

parameters.name: fileInfo

methods.name: onFile
methods.description: Invoked for any file no typed handler matched, and as the fallback when a typed handler is not declared. Content arrives as raw bytes.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The file's bytes. Declare the stream form to read large files in chunks rather than loading them into memory.

parameters.name: fileInfo
parameters.description: The file's name, path, size, and timestamps.

methods.name: onFileDelete
methods.description: Invoked when a file disappears from the watched directory. There is no content or file metadata, because the file is already gone.

parameters.name: deleteFiles
parameters.description: Path of the file that was deleted.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: The FTP connection, for acting on the share in response to the deletion.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Invoked when the listener fails to poll, read, or bind a file, and when a handler itself returns an error. Without it, failures are logged and polling continues.

parameters.name: ftpError
parameters.description: The failure that interrupted processing.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: The FTP connection, for acting on the share while handling the failure.

methods.name: onFileChange
methods.description: Invoked once per poll with the complete set of files added and deleted since the previous poll.

parameters.name: watchEvent
parameters.description: The files added and deleted in this poll.

methods.deprecated: Superseded by the typed content handlers. onFileChange only reports which files changed, leaving the read and the parse to the handler, whereas onFileText, onFileJson, onFileXml, onFileCsv and onFile deliver the file body already bound to a declared type.

annotations.name: FunctionConfig
annotations.description:
Annotation to configure FTP service remote functions.
This can be used to specify which file patterns should be handled by a particular content method
and what actions to perform after processing.

annotations.name: ServiceConfig
annotations.description:
Annotation to configure FTP service monitoring path and file patterns.
This annotation allows each service to define its own monitoring configuration,
enabling multiple services on a single listener to monitor different paths independently.
